final: WITH rating_stock AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS stock_count FROM inventory i JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), avg_stock AS (SELECT AVG(stock_count) AS avg_count FROM rating_stock), above_avg AS (SELECT stock_count FROM rating_stock rs CROSS JOIN avg_stock WHERE rs.stock_count > avg_stock.avg_count) SELECT SUM(stock_count) AS total_above_avg_films, AVG(stock_count) - (SELECT AVG(stock_count) FROM rating_stock) AS avg_distance_above_average FROM above_avg
